relationships.subject: C34
relationships.evidence_quote: As specific TLR4 inhibitor, we demonstrated in vitro and in vivo that C34 inhibited the catabolism of chondrocytes and promoted anabolism.

relationships.subject: C34
relationships.evidence_quote: C34 restrained pain response, alleviated the lameness, and suppressed expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) in mice after destabilized medial meniscus (DMM) surgery.

relationships.subject: C34
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, C34 was attributed to suppressing the NF-κB signaling pathways.

key_findings: TLR4 expression increased in human OA cartilage
TLR4 inhibitor C34 reduced pain, inflammation and angiogenesis in DMM mice via NF-κB suppression
